parsed.post: Discarding the 0.828061 run; it regressed from my best 0.819325. It seems my previous depth-8 jump was lucky or the learning rate is now too high for this configuration. I'll revert to the best (depth=8, lr=0.03) and try reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 for more stable refinement.
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR to 0.02 on the previous best configuration (depth=8, aspect=64, batch=262144) to see if a lower learning rate improves convergence and stability.
